facts.fact: Expose the Legitimacy Captain (Legitimacy; captain Councilor Ohmori): Captain arrested (t242-248).

facts.subject: arc outcome: The House Always Wins (Tag Night)
facts.fact: The House Always Wins (Tag Night) (Enforcement; captain Goki Banda): Shun and the debtor casters freed; hum broken; Banda killed by Mikoto's Riot Pulse; Haruto holds Yuji's duffel and the second ledger (t301-t326).

facts.subject: arc outcome: The Hostess Disappearance File
facts.fact: The Hostess Disappearance File (Finance; captain see ladder): Hostess Noa Amemiya goes missing; the crew finds Club Kagero (shuttered front, invite-only after-hours 'school'). Compressed by play: the crew breached it, pulled Noa out, and Jostin collapsed the club with the archive. Collectors then came for Noa's contract (Marumo Financial Services); the crew refused to pay.

facts.subject: arc outcome: Follow the Money
facts.fact: Follow the Money (Finance falls at the end; captain see ladder): Rin's numbers and the collectors point to a loan office on Neon Lantern Street that buys debts and ships cash by boat. The crew follows the money, survives the Thursday rematch crash and burns the master ledger at Harumi Wharf. Finance falls.

facts.subject: pressure curve
facts.fact: After Enforcement falls: Daigo annoyed; learns Banda skimmed; orders an audit (seeds 3b). | After Finance falls: broke and exposed; cannot pay his people. | After Intelligence falls: Daigo blind in Kobuncho; paranoid, trusts no one; the Act 2 finale hook.

facts.subject: hostesses
facts.fact: Club Lumiere hostesses: Airi Kurosawa, Mirei Tachibana, Noa Amemiya, Rika Saotome, Sena Amagawa (Reiko's younger sister, tattoos). Manager: Maki Hayashida.

facts.subject: money
facts.fact: Money (t327): Haruto's 70% safehouse fund stays locked with Haruto; 30% went to the party. Rin is Treasurer and head of Vault; a full member (probation ended, user t387).

facts.subject: divisions
facts.fact: Org (user-approved t387, final lists): joint Crew Heads Jovian and Jostin lead no division; Reiko is crew-wide Head Lieutenant (discipline, roster, training; open seat Trainer). RECRUITING is split by arm (user, t474; was Jostin's alone since t405): Jovian recruits for Spearhead seats, Jostin for Hearth seats; Reiko screens recruits only if asked. SPEARHEAD (the field, head Jovian): Command (Haruto head/strategist, Nobu intelligence), Strike (Mikoto), Vanguard (tank, Reiko), Phantom (head open; Kaito Arashima marksman; counter-intel seat), Aether (battle magic; all open), Lifeline (rescue and healing, Yuzuki). HEARTH (the home, head Jostin): Vault (money, Rin), Forge (gear, vehicles, papers; Hana), Pulse (media, cover and the Lantern network; Ayame), HearthOps (base operations, expansion, safehouse, territory and school; open), Arcanum (magic research, wards; open); Lumiere House support (Maki, Natsumi, hostesses). Open seats are recruitment goals; Rikona has NOT joined (never assume). FIRST WAVE (crew 11 -> 18): Aether Head (first caster/warder), Vanguard Shield, Phantom Infiltrator, Forge Driver, Forge Forger, Pulse Legal Counsel, HearthOps Community Liaison. Covered for now: Phantom head (Kaito acts), counter-intel (Nobu), training (Reiko), recruiting (Jostin), Lantern and facilities (Maki), wards (Aether Head). Plan ~26 by Act 3, mostly depth. Full chart: canon.json org.

facts.subject: kagero
facts.fact: Club Kagero ('heat haze', Neon Lantern Street): publicly shuttered satellite; in truth an invite-only after-hours front with a school on the closed upper floor. Collapsed into the earth at t327 (Peach Aftershock) with its archive.

facts.subject: noa-debt
facts.fact: Noa Amemiya's family debt is 4.6 million yen on a contract signed at noon. The man in the dark suit said 'buried paper is not erased paper'. Haruto: 'somebody still holds that contract'. Jovian chose not to pay; the crew will hunt the collectors.

facts.subject: seen
facts.fact: The crew and Noa were seen outside Kagero by evacuees, phones and guards (a guard shouted 'they've got the girl'); phones filmed the collapse. Nobu looped Kagero's feeds earlier, so the man's breach footage was replaced.

facts.subject: recognition
facts.fact: Reiko told the crew the man on the pavement is the suited watcher who loitered outside the annex during the captain job. No name or role above him is known.

facts.subject: leads
facts.fact: Known leads: Rin's courier lead from Genda Shuji's route; Rikona's memory of one collector's face near the Amemiya shop; Nobu's dead-number trace (last ping 11:40 at Neon Lantern Street).

facts.subject: handler-sedan
facts.fact: Nobu's evacuation footage (three phone angles) shows the suited handler walking to a parked sedan and calling someone before driving off; Nobu is running the plate (no owner yet). The beaten man was left on the pavement.

facts.subject: rest
facts.fact: Monday night after Kagero: crew rests at Club Lumiere. Maki gave Noa a room upstairs. Reiko is guarding the Amemiya shop tonight. Haruto: nobody moves on Finance until they have slept and mapped it; planning is tomorrow.

facts.subject: marumo
facts.fact: Marumo Financial Services is the lender on Noa's contract (a front). 4.6M yen principal grows with interest and handling fees to about 7.8M. Collectors Yoshida (senior) and Kato (younger) served a notice at the Amemiya shop: pay by sundown on Wednesday or the shop's inventory is taken as collateral.

facts.subject: leasing
facts.fact: The handler's sedan and the backup car belong to one leasing shell family (Kurosaki Vehicle Leasing, flagship branch in Kobuncho; not the Kurosawa or Kurokawa names). Account manager Yamaguchi offers discreet placements.

facts.subject: cash-run
facts.fact: Trial placement: small cash sum from Haruto's duffel; Marumo's courier collects at Shutter Alley after sundown on Wednesday and waits minutes; the silver card number is the only contact. Same evening as the collectors' return to the Amemiya shop. Crew split: cash run Jostin, Kaito Arashima, Haruto, Jovian; shop Mikoto, Reiko, Ayame, Yuzuki; ops Rin, Hana, Nobu.

facts.subject: no-safehouse
facts.fact: No safehouse exists yet (Forge spec is waiting). When a player says 'safehouse' they mean Club Lumiere.

facts.subject: hana-budget
facts.fact: Hana refused Jostin's Peach kit (static traps, snares, stickies): budget zero, stock thin, safehouse fund locked. She gave him a bandolier of old charge discs.

facts.subject: gym-crash
facts.fact: t411-t416: Three Kurokawa collectors (Matsumoto, Kazuya Oka, an unnamed man 2) were beaten on Tetsu Gym's doorstep by Jostin under Blackstar Dominion. All alive; man 2 critical. Low-level collectors; no client named; one phone with a call log. DM invented the names (kept as surnames only). Tetsu handles the street; Riko makes the anonymous ambulance call.

facts.subject: pc-powers-2
facts.fact: In play t388-t416: Jovian's Sixth Form Twin Soul and Zero Form Sovereign's Will both worked (new attempts); his weakness holds (Soul Burn drains him). Jostin: Eagle Vision (his, not Jovian's), Shadow Step (assassin training, no Peach), Blackstar Dominion (uncontrolled will; crushes pavement; spills onto bystanders), Peach Aftershock strikes, Peach flash step (treated as Gearshift; strain tears muscle). Hoshino Requiem (Jostin's forbidden technique) was named in play; details not recorded.

facts.subject: timestamps
facts.fact: Timestamps in prompts are ALLOWED (user, t395+).

facts.subject: finance-fell
facts.fact: Finance pillar fell at Harumi Wharf (t437). Haruto photographed every ledger page for a police file, then burned the master ledger; the Amemiya debt (5.9M) is cleared and Noa's indenture is void. Setsuko Okabe survived and left by sedan; no deadline or hook was set.

facts.subject: ayame-date
facts.fact: Jostin and Ayame kissed at the dorm path (t425). Ayame: 'That wasn't the date. You still owe me one.' Jostin told Ayame that Riko is a friend and sparring partner and promised a date once the Finance captain fell.

facts.subject: jovian-yuzuki
facts.fact: Jovian and Yuzuki kissed at the Student Clinic (t425); Yuzuki was flustered and apologetic. Jovian's persuasion skill rose from 5 to 6 at t435.

facts.subject: rei
facts.fact: Rei Ichinose is Principal Anya's neutral Academy (Internal Affairs) liaison. School matters only: no jurisdiction over Vault money, Rin or off-campus work. She lifts every mat after the last bell. t465: logged one unresolved 'material anomaly' (the immovable mat, blamed on humidity). t466: asked what the club actually intends. Open: whether she closes the item or escalates it.

facts.subject: anya-terms
facts.fact: Anya's terms for the club (t444-t449): a neutral liaison is required and she accepts only if Rei joins; the school gives no budget until the club proves itself. Club name in play: Joestar Community Outreach Club; Kashiwagi-sensei is Haruto's fallback advisor (Command track).

facts.subject: gym-hq
facts.fact: Club storefront is the gym storage room; a secret bomb-shelter HQ lies under a hatch beneath the mats. Hana and Nobu built a flush false-floor panel over it (t461-t462; one corner sounds hollow). Peach (Jostin) locked the mat over it at t464. Linking the shelter to another clubroom is a weeks-long dig, not a quick job. Anya need not know.

facts.subject: safehouse-fund
facts.fact: Safehouse fund is Yuji's raid cash: 70% locked with Haruto, who signs the rest; Rin booked the safehouse build and released a small first draw for the panel (t460). Vault money is the crew's; Rei has no reach over it.

facts.subject: courier-door
facts.fact: The 4-1 courier photographed the new base's clubroom door at the school gym (not Tetsu Gym, not the t440 stills). Jostin destroyed his phone; nothing was sent. Open question, deliberately unanswered: who told him which door.

facts.subject: hearth-fieldwork
facts.fact: Jostin has said that leading Hearth does not take him off fieldwork (user, t474; the original line is not in the repo). Spearhead is still Jovian's field.

facts.subject: org-balance
facts.fact: Balance ruling (director's call t474, by structure not by play): Spearhead is the outward arm (combat, intel, rescue) and now also holds TERRITORY (turf, patrols, the shop-owner alliance), moved from HearthOps; Jovian owns it. Hearth is the economy and home front: money, gear, media, base operations, expansion and NEW BUSINESSES (the cafe etc.), school and magic research; Jostin owns it and recruits for Hearth seats; Jovian recruits for Spearhead seats (user, t474). New businesses are started by Jostin, funded by Vault (Rin), run by a HearthOps head once recruited (his first recruit, so he can delegate). Jostin joins the field when it matters (his own line) but is not the default field hand. School Affairs stays in HearthOps (the earlier move to Jovian is reverted).

facts.subject: journal t5 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jostin and Jovian Joestar successfully registered their abilities with Hoshino. They both received their official Pulse wristbands and registration slips.

facts.subject: journal t14 (enteredSafeLocation)
facts.fact: Tetsu-san escorted Jovian and Jostin Joestar to the Tetsu Iron Palm Gym. There, they were introduced to the gym's regular members: Kaito, Riko, Sayaka, Genta, and Masaru.

facts.subject: journal t38 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jovian Joestar defeated the broad man, forcing the Kurokawa crew to concede the immediate conflict. Reiko and the tattooed hostess reached a tense agreement with the lean man regarding the debt repayment.

facts.subject: journal t52 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jovian Joestar and Mikoto collaborated to knock out the stocky second-year student during the battle test. The announcer and gallery witnessed the knockout as medical staff rushed to remove the unconscious student from the arena.

facts.subject: journal t53 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jostin Joestar and Mikoto collaborated to knock out the remaining second-year students, completing a round-one sweep of the battle test. The announcer and the gallery witnessed the swift victory, which was immediately recorded by Sera.

facts.subject: journal t69 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jovian Joestar officially signed the ownership transfer documents for Club Lumière. Aurelia Voss finalized the legal registration of the establishment under the Joestars' control.

facts.subject: journal t83 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jostin Joestar successfully stole the cash bag from the Noodle Shop crew's carrier using a stealthy distraction. The carrier and her minder discovered the theft immediately, causing panic among the crew members.

facts.subject: journal t84 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: The party successfully stole the cash bag from the Noodle Shop crew during a coordinated intercept operation. The theft was witnessed by the carrier, the minder, and a retired hero at the docks.

facts.subject: journal t86 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jostin Joestar captured a fleeing courier boy using his kusarigama and the IFILWPP ability. The capture was witnessed by Reiko and two Kurokawa muscle members on Neon Lantern Street.

facts.subject: journal t89 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jostin and Jovian successfully captured the Kurokawa minder and secured the stolen cash bag and intelligence. The operation was witnessed by the Kurokawa muscle and the captured courier.

facts.subject: journal t98 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jostin and Jovian Joestar decisively defeated the Kurokawa associates in Shutter Alley using high-intensity attacks. The wiry man conceded the fight and agreed to speak with the party.

facts.subject: journal t99 (majorRevelation)
facts.fact: The party extracted information from the wiry man, identifying Ohba as the route organizer operating out of a nearby bathhouse. This discovery provides the party with a direct lead to the organizer of the Kurokawa operation.

facts.subject: journal t101 (longRest)
facts.fact: The party spent the night recovering at the bathhouse under the care of Yuzuki Hoshino. Haruto Saionji revealed to Jostin Joestar that Yuzuki possesses an unmanifested Stand.

facts.subject: journal t106 (majorCharacterChange)
facts.fact: Yuzuki Hoshino manifested her Stand, Verdant Sylph, to protect the bathhouse doorway from a thrown bottle. The party witnessed her sudden shift in demeanor and combat capability as she defended her establishment.

facts.subject: journal t111 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Yuzuki Hoshino officially joined the group after accepting a Joestar gang kimono from Hana Kisaragi. The core crew and support staff of Club Lumière welcomed her as their new crewmate.

facts.subject: journal t115 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Kaito Arashima joined the crew as a ranged support specialist after being vouched for by Josuke Higashikata. He made a loud entrance by kicking open the security door of the Club Lumière office.

facts.subject: journal t119 (majorRevelation)
facts.fact: Gara revealed the identity of Daigo Renjiro as the mastermind behind the protection racket in Kobuncho. He explained Daigo's strategy of systemic economic strangulation and the mapping of underground tunnels to seize control of the district.

facts.subject: journal t120 (majorRevelation)
facts.fact: Gara revealed that Daigo Renjiro is the true mastermind who has usurped control of the Kurokawa syndicate and is using the underground tunnels to seize the district. The party learned that Daigo's operations likely involve the long-term disappearance of district workers.

facts.subject: journal t125 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: The Joestar Gang and their allies successfully neutralized 'Sickle' Sato's collection crew. Only Sato remains standing after the party systematically defeated his four heavies.

facts.subject: journal t129 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jovian Joestar and Jostin Joestar successfully neutralized the remaining heavies, leaving 'Sickle' Sato as the sole combatant. The group then coordinated a focused assault to break Sato's defensive web and leave him severely wounded.

facts.subject: journal t130 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jovian Joestar, Jostin Joestar, and their allies successfully defeated 'Sickle' Sato in a coordinated final assault. The collection leader was neutralized, and the remaining crew member surrendered.

facts.subject: journal t135 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jostin Joestar successfully rescued an elderly woman from a burning building. Local firefighters and the woman's daughter witnessed the rescue and the party's intervention.

facts.subject: journal t136 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: The Joestar crew delivered Sato's route sheet and keyring to Gara at the headquarters. Gara analyzed the intel, confirming that the death of the collector disrupted Daigo's financial artery and provided the party with a map of the money movement.

facts.subject: journal t165 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jostin Joestar delivered a public toast to the community of Kobuncho, cementing the club's image as a neighborhood sanctuary. This was witnessed by the gathered guests, including Ayame Fujinami and Sayaka Mizuhara.

facts.subject: journal t169 (alliance)
facts.fact: Jostin Joestar successfully networked the local shop owners of Kobuncho, fostering a collaborative atmosphere and a provisional alliance. This social engineering was witnessed by the gathered merchants, Sayaka Mizuhara, and Riko Amane.

facts.subject: journal t179 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jovian Joestar defeated Marlon Velez using a high-intensity Desperation Impact barrage. Daigo Renjiro acknowledged the victory as the first audition successfully completed.

facts.subject: journal t180 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Reiko Amagawa and Mikoto Kurogane defeated Vera Sable and Toma Genda respectively during the audition fights. Daigo Renjiro observed the victories and declared that the final exchange between Jostin Joestar and Iori Vale would determine the district's fate.

facts.subject: journal t181 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jostin Joestar defeated Iori Vale after disarming himself to prove his sincerity, leading her to agree to try changing her life. Daigo Renjiro then activated a remote control mechanism, seizing control of the defeated elites' bodies.

facts.subject: journal t182 (companionDeath)
facts.fact: Jostin Joestar accidentally killed Iori Vale after she was puppeted into the path of his strike by Daigo Renjiro. Iori died in Jostin's arms, expressing gratitude for his trust before passing away.

facts.subject: journal t185 (enteredSafeLocation)
facts.fact: The crew successfully retreated from the canal alley to the safety of Club Lumière. They arrived battered and carrying Iori Vale's body, where they were met by a stricken Maki Hayashida.

facts.subject: journal t187 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jostin Joestar single-handedly defeated the Kurokawa forces on Neon Lantern Street. The remaining attackers were repelled by the coordinated efforts of the crew and Haruto Saionji.

facts.subject: journal t189 (majorRevelation)
facts.fact: Jostin Joestar released a massive wave of raw pressure that knocked out multiple people across the Kobuncho district. The event was witnessed by the entire party and numerous civilians and enemies in the surrounding area.

facts.subject: journal t190 (majorRevelation)
facts.fact: Jostin Joestar revealed the name of the raw power he unleashed as 'Blackstar Dominion' while receiving medical treatment. The event was overheard by Maki Hayashida and observed by the remaining crew members at Club Lumière.

facts.subject: journal t192 (majorRevelation)
facts.fact: Haruto Saionji detailed the structure of Daigo Renjiro's organization, identifying the four pillars of its power. Reiko Amagawa and Jovian Joestar agreed to target the 'Legitimacy' pillar first to strip Daigo of his public and legal protections.

facts.subject: journal t203 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jostin and his team coerced Sonobe into revealing the existence of a secret ledger containing falsified licensing permits. The licensing officer admitted to copying the Legitimacy captain's illegal records after being confronted with evidence.

facts.subject: journal t205 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jostin Joestar and Ayame Fujinami successfully secured verified copies of the compromised licensing records from Sonobe. The records identify eleven officials and confirm the Legitimacy captain's rigid Thursday routine.

facts.subject: journal t207 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jovian Joestar defeated the barrel-chested fighter with a decisive roundhouse kick, earning the respect of Old Man Koga. Koga subsequently granted Jovian sole access to the Enforcement captain's office.

facts.subject: journal t214 (majorRevelation)
facts.fact: Jostin Joestar neutralized a hostile watcher in the alleyway, while Jovian Joestar's party discovered a collection of Kurokawa dues and manifests in the warehouse. The party's actions have uncovered the logistics of Daigo's financial operations in Kobuncho.

facts.subject: journal t217 (majorRevelation)
facts.fact: Jostin Joestar used Eagle Vision to locate sensitive documents and a wall safe in the Records room. Meanwhile, Jovian Joestar and Reiko Amagawa coerced Hayashi into revealing that the Enforcement captain uses falsified signatures as leverage over him.

facts.subject: journal t218 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jostin Joestar successfully breached the wall safe in the Records room and gathered damning evidence against the Legitimacy captain. Simultaneously, Jovian Joestar and Reiko Amagawa coerced Hayashi into surrendering the original manifests and cooperating with the party.

facts.subject: journal t219 (majorRevelation)
facts.fact: Jovian Joestar and Reiko Amagawa coerced Hayashi into revealing the enforcement captain's location and delivery schedule at the pit circuit. This intel provides the party with a direct lead to the enforcement captain's operations.

facts.subject: journal t224 (majorRevelation)
facts.fact: Ayame Fujinami discovered Councilor Ohmori's authorization stamp on forged licenses. This revelation suggests the corruption extends to the ward's business licensing committee.

facts.subject: journal t242 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: The Legitimacy captain signed the forged payment authorization in public, unaware that Ayame Fujinami captured the act on camera. The party has secured the necessary evidence to expose the captain's corruption.

facts.subject: journal t243 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Ayame publicly exposed the Legitimacy captain's corruption in the licensing annex, prompting a violent confrontation between the party and the captain's enforcers. The captain attempted to flee the scene with the signed forgery while his guards attempted to protect him.

facts.subject: journal t246 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jostin Joestar successfully snatched the forged authorization from the Legitimacy captain's jacket. The party engaged the captain in a street brawl as police sirens approached, while bystanders and a mysterious observer filmed the encounter.

facts.subject: journal t247 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jovian Joestar completely destroyed the Legitimacy captain's getaway vehicle, leaving the captain trapped for the arriving police. The party successfully retreated into a service corridor with the forged document and footage after Ayame distributed the evidence to the press.

facts.subject: journal t248 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: The party successfully retreated to Club Lumière after exposing the Legitimacy captain's corruption. The evidence was broadcast on the noon news, confirming the captain's arrest and the public nature of the scandal.

facts.subject: journal t268 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: The party agreed that Yuzuki Hoshino would act as a disguised stand-in to fight Kenji Aoi. Haruto Saionji formalized the terms of her participation and the group's strategy.

facts.subject: journal t277 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Yuzuki Hoshino shattered Kenji Aoi's triple-layer barrier and launched a devastating wind attack. The entire student crowd and the betting collectors witnessed the sudden collapse of Kenji's defense.

facts.subject: journal t278 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Yuzuki Hoshino defeated Kenji Aoi after a devastating final clash, leaving him scorched in the mud. The entire student crowd and betting collectors witnessed the victory as the embankment erupted in celebration.

facts.subject: journal t279 (crime)
facts.fact: Jostin Joestar stole the payout satchel from Yuji and threw the money into the crowd. This caused a chaotic scramble among the students and distracted the collectors and security.

facts.subject: journal t280 (enteredSafeLocation)
facts.fact: The party successfully retreated from the riverbank and reached the safety of Club Lumière. Rikona Mibu agreed to accompany Jostin to the club after expressing her fear of the collectors.

facts.subject: journal t309 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jovian and Mikoto defeated Vise and Paper Cut in the bunker arena. Meanwhile, Jostin neutralized the handler Tatsuya in the annex, though a security guard was alerted and is descending into the basement.

facts.subject: journal t311 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jovian Joestar defeated Iwao in the bunker arena, securing victory in the first round of Tag Night. The victory was witnessed by the crowd and the facility manager, Banda.

facts.subject: journal t316 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jovian Joestar defeated Goro in the arena, while Jostin Joestar ambushed the overseer in the humming room to facilitate the prisoners' escape. The victory and the infiltration were witnessed by the arena crowd, Banda, and the prisoners.

facts.subject: journal t322 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jovian Joestar launched a devastating assault on Banda, knocking him into the cage mesh. Banda subsequently collapsed as his enhancement syringe failed, leaving him defeated on the arena floor.

facts.subject: journal t323 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jovian Joestar and Mikoto Kurogane neutralized Banda and secured the arena floor. The party successfully evacuated the prisoners and recovered the house ledgers before fleeing the district as police sirens approached.

facts.subject: journal t324 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: The party successfully evacuated the arena with the rescued prisoners and secured a ledger revealing Banda's embezzlement from Daigo. This operation was streamed by Ayame, causing the defeat of The House to trend socially.

facts.subject: journal t337 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: The crew hired Rin, a former clerk from the House, to manage their finances and operational logistics. She accepted the position under a strict one-month probation period overseen by Nobu.

facts.subject: journal t345 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: The party successfully executed the first trial event night at Club Lumière, integrating a hostess showcase and gathering direct feedback from regulars. The event concluded with the hostesses entering the floor and Jostin exiting the bar top.

facts.subject: journal t346 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: The party successfully concluded the trial operational night at Club Lumière, exceeding revenue projections by twenty-two percent. Rin identified necessary adjustments for pricing and volume to optimize future events.

facts.subject: journal t361 (majorRevelation)
facts.fact: Jostin and Jovian interrogated the suited handler and two women at the wrecked van. The handler revealed that Noa Amemiya was taken to Club Kagerō, the organization's main house.

facts.subject: journal t368 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jovian Joestar breached the reinforced door to Noa Amemiya's room using Soul Pierce. Noa was found unharmed, though the action alerted nearby guards to their presence.

facts.subject: journal t369 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jovian Joestar rescued Noa Amemiya by forcibly removing her from her room through a second-story window. This action was witnessed by the club's evacuees and security staff.

facts.subject: journal t370 (majorLocationChange)
facts.fact: Jostin Joestar used Peach Aftershock to collapse the front facade of Club Kagerō, burying the building's records. This act of destruction was witnessed by the evacuees, security staff, and the man in the dark suit on Neon Lantern Street.

facts.subject: journal t374 (enteredSafeLocation)
facts.fact: The party returned to Club Lumière after successfully rescuing Noa and destroying Club Kagerō. Haruto Saionji briefed the group on their strategy to dismantle Daigo Renjiro's organization by targeting its remaining pillars.

facts.subject: journal t409 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jovian Joestar successfully executed Heaven's Impact, driving Kaito Serizawa into the mat with a contained shockwave. Tetsu and several observers confirmed the technique was delivered with precise control over the environment.

facts.subject: journal t410 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jovian Joestar defeated Kaito Serizawa in their rematch using Falling Star Palm without damaging the gym floor. The victory was witnessed by Tetsu, gym staff, and a live-stream audience.

facts.subject: journal t415 (crime)
facts.fact: Jostin Joestar killed Kazuya Oka and brutally assaulted Matsumoto before answering a call from their mysterious employer. The violent act was witnessed by Jovian Joestar, Genta Oda, and Sayaka Mizuhara.

facts.subject: journal t424 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Nobu Takamine successfully completed the drone reconnaissance of the loan office. The footage confirmed the office serves as the counting hub for the Finance Captain's operations.

facts.subject: journal t432 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: The party successfully tracked a cash collection van to Harumi Wharf using a magnetic tag. They discovered the funds are being loaded onto a cargo boat scheduled to sail on Monday.

facts.subject: journal t437 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jostin Joestar successfully retrieved the master ledger containing the debts of the local branch, including the Amemiya account. Setsuko Okabe offered to void the Amemiya debt and Noa's contract in exchange for the ledger's return.

facts.subject: journal t438 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jostin Joestar physically assaulted Setsuko Okabe before Haruto Saionji burned the master ledger to void the Amemiya and Noa debts. The guards and Setsuko witnessed the assault, while the ledger's destruction was confirmed by Haruto.

facts.subject: journal t449 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jovian Joestar and Haruto Saionji successfully persuaded Principal Anya to approve the Community Service club and serve as its advisor. Anya signed the club charter on the condition of weekly reports and full access to the storage room.

facts.subject: journal t468 (alliance)
facts.fact: Jovian Joestar confessed the existence of the underground base to Rei Ichinose to secure her silence. Rei deleted the material anomaly report and agreed to a provisional alliance, provided the club remains unobtrusive.

facts.subject: journal t470 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jovian and Jostin Joestar met with Principal Anya to confirm Rei Ichinose's satisfaction with the club's status. Principal Anya granted the club a provisional filing, allowing them to conduct after-school activities.

facts.subject: journal t471 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jostin and Jovian Joestar officially established the Joestar Community Outreach Club with a provisional charter from Principal Anya. The club's existence is now publicly announced via Ayame Fujinami's social media feed.

facts.subject: journal t478 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jostin Joestar disabled the Kurokawa sedan by detonating its tire and violently extracted the occupants from the vehicle. The Driver was slammed onto the asphalt and restrained by Jostin's kusarigamas.

facts.subject: journal t479 (majorMilestone)
facts.fact: Jostin and Jovian successfully intercepted the Kurokawa sedan and interrogated the driver and lookouts. The driver revealed the deputy's location at a storeroom on Steam Lantern Alley.

facts.subject: iori vale (resolved)
facts.fact: Iori Vale is dead: Jostin killed her by accident at t182 when Daigo Renjiro puppeted her into the path of his strike; she died in Jostin's arms, thanking him for his trust; the crew carried her body to Club Lumière (t185). Earlier sources said coma or freed; the save settles it.
facts.evidence: Voyage journal t182 companionDeath and t185 enteredSafeLocation (worlds/joestar-save.json)

facts.subject: kaito arashima (member)
facts.fact: Kaito Arashima is a full crew member: he joined as ranged support at t115, vouched for by Josuke Higashikata, and is in Voyage's party. The old 'still deciding' note was a character beat, not a membership question.
facts.evidence: Voyage journal t115 majorMilestone; partyState.partyMembers at t481

facts.subject: okabe (known)
facts.fact: Setsuko Okabe's name is known to the crew and the players since Harumi Wharf (t434-t439): she introduced herself in play, offered to void the Amemiya debt, took Jostin's three slaps and walked away; the master ledger was burned. The nickname 'The Teller' never appeared in the story.

facts.subject: calendar (Voyage)
facts.fact: Voyage's Day 1 is Saturday, August 1, 2026 (the story start); Day 20 is Thursday, August 20, 2026, evening. Anya's weekly club report is due Fridays (Day 21 is the next).
facts.evidence: Voyage storyStart 'Dawn, Day 1: Saturday, August 1, 2026'; partyState.day 20; t449-t457 charter terms

facts.subject: locations (Voyage)
facts.fact: Club Lumière, Tetsu Iron Palm Gym and Ward Licensing Services are locations of their own in Voyage's world (not areas of Kobuncho). Club Lumière rooms: Main Lounge, Back Office, Kitchen, Stage Alcove, Storage Closet. The Academy gym wing is the area combat-gym.

facts.subject: party roster (Voyage)
facts.fact: Voyage's party at t481: Jostin, Jovian, Kaito Arashima, Ayame Fujinami, Reiko, Mikoto, Hana, Haruto Saionji, Nobu, Rikona Mibu, Yuzuki Hoshino, Rin. The engine lists Rikona, but the story shows no ask or yes: she is not in the crew yet.
facts.evidence: partyState.partyMembers; no Rikona join event in the journal or the t382-t481 summaries

facts.subject: alley cast (Voyage names)
facts.fact: Voyage's records name the SEDAN DRIVER Ryota Kobayashi and the van's Driver Yuji Hara; the names have not appeared in the story: keep the labels SEDAN DRIVER, VAN DRIVER, Lookout 1 and Lookout 2.
facts.evidence: npcs 'Ryota Kobayashi' (name SEDAN DRIVER) and 'Yuji Hara' (name Driver), last seen t481

facts.subject: records deputy (t479-t481)
facts.fact: The records deputy waits tonight in the storeroom over a closed noodle counter on Steam Lantern Alley (the sedan driver blurted it, t479). The driver answered his 'Status?' and the deputy replied 'Who is with you? Back stairs, now.' (t481); Lookout 2 warned him by burner phone.
